stance_rationale: The package knowingly ships a walk-forward schedule with turnover_annual_rt=6.4259, above the 600% hard fail, and treats disclosure as sufficient remediation. Additional CVaR, schedule-schema, method-consistency, and sequential-admission gaps mean this is not Forge-ready.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: HRP selected after TDC penalty; method_shopping_log exists in stage_artifacts, but package method_comparison omits crowding_adj_ret and reports HRP net_ir=0.7331 while the log reports HRP net_ir=0.8142.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Arithmetic is consistent: 6.4259 x 15bps = 0.0096, equivalent to one-way turnover x 15bps x 2. The issue is not cost math; it is RF-O13 hard turnover breach.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O8 optimizer CVaR monthly -0.0699 static / -0.0994 walk-forward exceeds risk-side 0.025 monthly cap without CVaR-specific infeasibility handling

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Not reported; no blended 80/20 or alternative active-book SR/MDD/IR table.

critical_concerns.description: RF-O13 is active: walk-forward annual round-trip turnover is 6.4259, above the 6.0 hard fail. Issuing an infeasibility_report does not make the weights admissible; the package still selects HRP and hands the schedule to Forge.

RF-O8 is unresolved: risk_package flags CVaR cap breach and Hill alpha=1.4516 heavy-tail caution, while optimizer reports CVaR(5%)=-0.0699 static and -0.0994 walk-forward but does not issue a CVaR-specific infeasibility report or impose a CVaR budget.

weights.csv does not match the required schema: it has Date,Ticker,Weight only, no method_selected; the mailbox path qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260429_001/weights.csv is absent; and 124 schedule dates violate abs(sum_w-1)<1e-6 after rounding.

The walk-forward generator is not the same method as the as-of target: non-anchor dates use per-date top-20 by alpha_z then HRP, while the 2026-03-31 anchor uses HRP over top-60 then takes highest HRP weights. This weakens the claim that the 279-date schedule validates the selected target portfolio.
The hypothesis is regime-conditional defense, but optimizer provides no per-regime weights, no crisis cash sleeve, no crisis max_w shrink to 0.10, and no regime-switch cost internalization.

Method-shopping evidence is internally inconsistent: HRP net_ir is 0.8142 in method_shopping_log_optimizer.json but 0.7331 in optimization_package_draft.json; lineage records method_shopping_log_ref as null despite the log existing.

RF-O1 signal realization is weak: only 10 of the top-20 alpha names are held, and 22 of the top-35 alpha names have zero weight. Risk constraints can justify exclusions, but the package does not quantify alpha loss from this HRP-first selection.
Sequential Admission is incomplete: no replacement vs integration scenarios, no blended SR/MDD/IR, and no active-book allocation table are reported despite TDC being the core admission argument.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet is a true time-series artifact: 84194 rows, 279 Dates, Date/Ticker/alpha_z schema, no Date-Ticker duplicates.
covariance.parquet is PSD with min_eig=0.001722 and condition_number=59.415, passing the post-shrink cond <= 100 gate.
The as-of target portfolio has 20 names, long-only weights, max target weight 0.0906, and sum_w=1.0.
The stage weights schedule has 279 dates and 20 names per date, so this is not the Iter 4 single-snapshot bug.
Cost arithmetic is proportional to 15bps, but that does not cure the turnover hard fail.
unresolved_disputes: User-specified artifact dirs qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260429_001 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260429_001 are absent; actual artifacts used are under stage_artifacts/WT-D20260429_001.
CVaR unit treatment remains disputed: risk Round 2 accepted monthly cap=0.025, while optimizer code uses a heavy-tail-adjusted daily-equivalent threshold.
Forge production-grade NAV is still pending; optimizer labels its walk-forward simulation production_grade=false.
Static TDC q5 passes at 0.2143, but static q10 is 0.4815; the package does not justify why q5 alone is sufficient for admission.
No optimizer_challenge_note.md file exists, although challenge_flags and an embedded infeasibility_report are present in the package.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that disclosure of a turnover hard fail is enough to pass a weights schedule downstream without first rerunning buffer-zone, alpha smoothing, or transaction-cost-penalized optimization.
rebuttal_required: Provide a remediated weights.csv with annual round-trip turnover < 6.0 and abs(sum_w-1)<1e-6 for every date.
Add method_selected to weights.csv and document the exact same optimizer rule for every sig_date, including fallback dates.
Issue a CVaR-specific infeasibility_report or enforce a CVaR-budget/tail-aware constraint consistent with risk_package CF-RISK-02.
Produce regime-specific schedule or explicitly retire the regime-conditional claim for optimizer admission.
Report replacement and integration scenarios versus STR_1715/PG2 active book with blended SR, MDD, IR, turnover, and cost.
Reconcile HRP net_ir=0.8142 vs 0.7331 and attach method_shopping_log_optimizer.json in lineage.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Alpha and covariance artifacts are materially improved, but optimizer admission fails on hard turnover, unresolved CVaR risk, and incomplete integration evidence. This is a remediation task, not a Forge handoff.

optimizer_specific_questions: 이 weights를 22년 시계열에 적용 가능한가? Multi-date schedule exists, but RF-O13 turnover hard fail makes it inadmissible without remediation.
method_shopping에서 net_IR 1위가 cost-adjusted 또는 heavy-tail-adjusted에서도 1위인가? Not proven; HRP net_ir is inconsistent across package and log, and heavy-tail CVaR handling is not explicit.
RF-O8 CVaR breach 시 infeasibility_report 발행했는가, 아니면 silent override 했는가? Turnover report exists, but CVaR-specific infeasibility handling is missing.
Sequential Admission vs PG2 active book TDC가 cross-section vs time-series 어느 것인가? Reported q5 is time-series lower-tail co-occurrence vs STR_1715; integration portfolio metrics are missing.
